name: Hookdeck

evidence.jobs: C02: Event Gateway provides durable event queueing with retries; J03: at-least-once delivery

line: Queue and route webhook events with retries and delivery logs.

free.text: 10K events/mo; 3-day retention; no idle pause or deletion rule

cells.metered: Event Gateway Team $39/mo; Outpost 50k deliveries free
cells.regions: Gateway region unknown; Outpost Growth has US, EU, and Asia

sql.math: Hookdeck handles events, not SQL databases
Hookdeck handles events, not SQL databases

files.math: Hookdeck does not provide file storage.

jobs.math: Hookdeck charges for processed events or deliveries to each destination, not for worker seconds. 10,000 jobs do not show either count.
